channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Kirk Hinrich | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Kirk Hinrich from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Kirk Hinrich
item.description:
KC Johnson:Zach LaVine on franchise record for made 3-pointers, passing Kirk Hinrich:

“Great accomplishment. Whenever you keep climbing up the ladder on certain things, it’s a tribute to your hard work. Kirk is one of the all-time great guys here, a helluva player. So my hat’s off to him.”

Zach LaVine on Kirk Hinrich, Nov 30, 2024. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Kirk Hinrich
item.description:
KC Johnson:Thibodeau, on Hinrich's return:

“It was huge for us. Basically he saved us the last two seasons.”

Tom Thibodeau on Kirk Hinrich, Jul 18, 2014. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: LeBron James on Kirk Hinrich, Taj Gibson
item.description:
“I believe and I know that a lot of my fouls are not basketball plays. First of all, Kirk Hinrich in the first quarter basically grabbed me with two hands and brought me to the ground. The last one, Taj Gibson was able to collar me around my shoulder and bring me to the ground. Those are not defensive ... those are not basketball plays.”

LeBron James on Kirk Hinrich, Taj Gibson, Mar 28, 2013. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Kirk Hinrich
item.description:
Thibs on Hinrich injury:

“I don’t know how serious it is. If he needs time, he’ll get it. If he doesnt, he’ll play.”

Tom Thibodeau on Kirk Hinrich, Oct 24, 2012. Source: Sulia.

item.title: Derrick Rose on Kirk Hinrich
item.description:
Michael Lee:Derrick Rose on Hinrich:

“Kirk meant a lot. I was kind of mad at the time that we lost him. He's a guy that we're definitely going to miss”

Derrick Rose on Kirk Hinrich, Oct 8, 2010. Source: Twitter.
